Iranian lives and national sovereignty must never become bargaining chips in regional diplomacy.

For 48 years, Iranians have endured the consequences of the Islamic Republic’s theocratic rule. I lost seven members of my family in January 2026. This is not an abstract political debate for me; it is a personal tragedy that no diplomatic formula can erase. I will not accept foreign governments treating the suffering of Iranian families as an expendable detail in their negotiations.

I am an Iranian nationalist, not a politician and not a monarchist. I believe Iran belongs to the Iranian people. We do not need foreign governments imposing their agendas, legitimising the status quo or presenting diplomatic proposals
